items.title: What are urban local bodies and what are their functions?
items.explanation: Urban local bodies, such as Municipal Corporations or City Councils, are decentralized government structures that manage infrastructure, garbage collection, water services, and economic development in cities. They operate under state governments rather than a central authority, allowing citizens living in an area to directly participate in decisions affecting their community.

items.title: Why are they important in governance and democracy?
items.explanation: Urban local bodies empower citizens by providing them with direct say on how their areas are managed. This mechanism ensures that people can actively participate in their country's functioning at the urban level, fostering a deeper understanding of administration, franchise, rights, and privileges within their own town.
